svg.title: Тяга штанги к поясу с упором грудью — положение 2
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. Barbell seal row with a chest support. Side three-quarter view of the same athlete lying fully face down on a long flat elevated rowing bench, chest and front of legs in contact, feet toward rear. Bench high enough for one free barbell to hang beneath it. Single recognizable straight barbell with round plates on BOTH ends, hands gripping it a little wider than shoulders. LEFT arms hang vertically down holding barbell clear of floor. RIGHT elbows bend back and up, bringing barbell toward the underside of bench at lower ribs/waist level. Bench remains flat, chest in contact, no cables or separate dumbbells. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
